scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
author: /root
design: Replace CPU-boolean inference with a VM-specific writer-owner capability created only at an actual selected writer acquisition, carrying the real lock/node/IRQ ownership and a stable VM reference. Derive types from selected implementations; use internal Rust types, not guessed public C ABI.

The nested stack/fault callee must never drop a writer based on the CPU marker. Move suspension to a safe checkpoint owned by the actual clear_host_pte/offload caller BEFORE host offload can synchronously reenter fault handling.

At that owner checkpoint pin all VM/range/attachment/page objects still needed across offload, snapshot the transaction/restart boundary and reserve the precise affected intervals. Defer physical reclamation/reuse until the existing real host completion; never synthesize a response or ACK. If a safe checkpoint cannot be established, keep that exact path incomplete rather than release a lock unsafely.

The owner releases its own real writer/IRQ state at the checkpoint. Nested fault handling acquires the actual fault VM writer normally; no borrowed ownership is inferred for a different VM. Waiting for another reservation must release the waiter writer and revalidate after reacquisition.

After real offload completion the owner reacquires the same VM writer, discards all pre-unlock range-derived pointers/iteration assumptions, relooks up and revalidates before continuing or restarts from the recorded transaction boundary. All selected callers must consume the internal typed restart outcome.

Same-owner recursion must progress without waiting on its own reservation. Implement the real pending-transaction/fault path according to the existing logical mapping state; no invented errno, dummy completion, arbitrary timeout, feature exclusion or assumed non-overlap. Preserve interval overlap and alias checks, mutation/teardown participation and exact reference drops.
deliverables: real internal owner-frame/token, checkpoint/resume and stack-provider code
selected clear_host_pte/offload and stack/fault caller integration with exact restart points
caller/mutator coverage and lock/ref/IRQ state transition tests
explicit remaining genuinely unimplemented paths; no claimed safety from a prototype
limits: Private source implementation and experimental compile contribution only. Canonical/shared ABI adoption belongs Root. Independent changed lifetime/locking review required before runtime. No native/build/resource/controller/policy/billing grant, no service hold clearance.
